description: Code defaults in force during the 16 October 2026 study, extracted once from the code at studyCommit. The manuscript's Disclosures section quotes these study-time values; scripts/eval/manuscriptTables.js reads them from this file, so the check does not need the git history (a shallow CI clone or a copy without .git still works). When studyCommit is reachable, manuscriptTables.js also re-reads each value from the code at that commit and stops on any difference. Pinned in FROZEN_HASHES.json; never edit it. A value that changes later gets its own record and macro.
extractedWith: git show 6dbe6b8:<file>, the default literal of the line given

CLAIM_RATE_LIMIT_MAX.unit: claim writes per hour per user
